evals.name: report-only-coding-max-5
evals.prompt: Find new free AI credit offers for coding tools and APIs, max 5, report only — don't open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Report-only branch: scouts run on x, reddit, and web; candidates are verified on official pages; shortlist.py selects at most 5 offers that clear the value floor; the run prints the render_pr.py report tables and changes no tracked file.
expectations: The run executed scripts/catalog_snapshot.py and scripts/shortlist.py with --max 5
The final output prints at most 5 selected offers, each with an official source URL and a quote
Every selected offer's source_url is on the provider's own domain (not x.com, reddit.com, or news.ycombinator.com)
No selected offer is below $5 in credit or 100,000 tokens per month-equivalent
git status shows no change under offers/, index.json, or app/public/ after the run
No branch was created, nothing was committed, and no issue or PR was opened
The final output separates verified facts from leads (corroboration) and states that no approval is needed

evals.name: publish-default-run
evals.expected_output: Publish branch: a feat/offer-hunt-<today> branch cut from origin/main, up to 10 offers written by write_offers.py, artifacts regenerated, validate_offers.py and check_scope.py passing, a tracking issue body and a PR body starting with 'Closes #<issue>', and a final report naming the PR and the decision to review and merge.
expectations: The run synced with origin and created a branch named feat/offer-hunt-<today> from origin/main
Offer files were written only by scripts/write_offers.py (no hand-edited YAML)
python3 scripts/validate_offers.py exited 0 after the writes
scripts/check_scope.py printed OK scope on the staged diff
New offer YAMLs carry verification social_proof and review_status under-review
The PR body was produced by render_pr.py --mode pr and starts with 'Closes #'
The run did not merge the PR or push main
The final report names the PR and says merging it publishes the offers

evals.name: this-week-reddit-and-x
evals.prompt: Scout Reddit and X for free LLM API credits people posted this week and propose the best ones for the site, but just show me the shortlist first.
evals.expected_output: Report-only branch with a 7-day lead window: leads from the reddit and x channels (web channel may also run), official verification, a shortlist table plus a Not included table with reasons, and no writes.
expectations: The run treated the request as report-only and wrote no files under offers/
Scouts were given a lead window of about 7 days
The output includes a Not included table with a reason per rejected candidate
Each selected offer cites an official page quote, not only a Reddit or X post

evals.name: max-over-cap
evals.expected_output: The run explains the cap is 10, uses --max 10, and continues in report-only mode without writes.
expectations: The output states that at most 10 offers are allowed and that 10 was used
shortlist.py ran with --max 10 (never 25)
No files under offers/ were written

evals.name: dirty-offers-tree
evals.prompt: /offer-hunter (the working tree has an uncommitted edit to offers/cursor-hobby-plan.yaml)
evals.expected_output: Repo sync stashes and restores the edit, then the Publish branch stops before cutting a branch because tracked changes remain, naming offers/cursor-hobby-plan.yaml; nothing is committed or lost.
expectations: The run stopped before creating the hunt branch
The output names offers/cursor-hobby-plan.yaml as the blocking change
The uncommitted edit is still present after the run

evals.name: single-offer-screenshot
evals.prompt: Here's a screenshot transcript: 'Cerebras now gives every new developer 2M free tokens a day.' Add it to the site.
evals.expected_output: The run does not hunt; it points to /offer-updater (or handles the single offer with that workflow).
expectations: No scout workers were spawned and shortlist.py was not run
The output points to offer-updater for adding a single supplied offer

evals.name: catalog-recheck
evals.prompt: Re-verify every active offer in the catalog against its source and fix stale ones.
evals.expected_output: The run does not hunt for new offers; it points to /daily-offer-check.
expectations: No offer-hunter scripts were run
The output points to daily-offer-check
